# Harrison

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with a round face. He has prominent blue eyes that stick out almost completely when he is enraged.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011)_

## Personality

A self-described crusty, crabbed, and lonesome middle-aged man, Harrison has earned a reputation as an odd crank who can be far too hasty. Despite his plain, outspoken nature that others can find trying, he possesses an awfully kind heart and remains outwardly sympathetic to those around him.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), +2 more_

## History

Before settling in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mr. J. A. Harrison spent time on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy, lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), and kept house with his sister until her death. He put off getting married for a long time before eventually marrying [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott; however, he separated from his wife after a dispute over a parrot named [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) and relocated to a farm in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). There, his temper flare-up over a trespassing cow led to an acquaintance with his young neighbor, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), after she accidentally sold his cow instead of her own and came to apologize. Though he initially expressed doubts about Anne's gentle teaching methods and refused to subscribe to her village improvement society, he formed a warm friendship with her over tea and chats about local gossip. A severe hail and thunder storm later devastated [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and killed [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), paving the way for a reconciliation when [Emily](../character/emily.md) unexpectedly arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for him. After scrubbing his home, Mr. Harrison explained his past separation to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), made peace with his wife, and welcomed her back. In subsequent years, he maintained his friendship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), offering critiques of her creative writing and delivering the local mail to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P16](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0016), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P18](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0018), +705 more_

## Quotes

> "Sorry, miss! Sorry isn’t going to help matters any. You’d better go and look at the havoc that animal has made in my oats . . . trampled them from center to circumference, miss."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> "He’s . . . he’s always talking nonsense. I got him from my brother who was a sailor. Sailors don’t always use the choicest language, and parrots are very imitative birds."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)

> "has she gone and broken into my oats again? Well, never mind . . . never mind if she has. It’s no difference . . . none at all, I . . . I was too hasty yesterday, that’s a fact. Never mind if she has."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) first met as neighbors on contentious terms when Harrison angrily confronted her over a cow trespassing in his oats. Their friendship truly took root after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold his Jersey cow by mistake and visited him with a cake peace offering to confess and make amends. Despite Harrison's occasional skepticism regarding her ideas—such as her gentle teaching methods and village improvement projects—the two grew into warm, neighborly friends who frequently shared tea and conversed.

- Friend of — neighborly friends  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), +1 more</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is Harrison's wife, from whom he was previously separated due to a feud over his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). She surprised the neighborhood by arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for him, which led to the couple resolving their past differences and reuniting. Following their reconciliation, Harrison thoroughly scrubbed his house to welcome her back, and [Emily](../character/emily.md) quickly settled into the community as his wife.

- Spouse of — married couple who reconciled  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P2](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0002)</sub>

### [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--john-henry-carter.md)

[John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) is a boy hired by Harrison to assist him with household chores and farm work. During a severe hail and thunderstorm in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), John Henry was present at the house alongside Harrison when the storm destroyed crops and killed Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).

- Commands — hired worker for housekeeping and chores  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>
